generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | xxd -p | tr -d "\n"  # plain=cobalt-otter-17: PLAIN hex (xxd -p), bytes are printable text -> owned by hex, not septets
oracle_cmd: python3 -I -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,\"tools/pylib-gsm\");from gsmmodem.pdu import unpackSeptets,decodeGsm7;print(decodeGsm7(unpackSeptets(bytes.fromhex(sys.argv[1].replace(\" \",\"\")))))" "$encoded"  # gsmmodem unpacks it to junk (not the text); xxd -r -p reads cobalt-otter-17 directly
